matches.rationale: No finding addresses the corrupted Eq. (3) in Section 2.1 (the sum-of-ΔW_i x^{m_i} decomposition replacing the block-concatenation form); pred 2 critiques Eq. (13) in 2.2.4 and the general nonlinearity of attention, a different locus and a pre-existing looseness.

Pred 3 flags exactly the attention normaliser in Section 2.2.2, noting that √d mis-binds d (projected tokens live in R^r, so √r is the right constant) and that the duplicate equations elsewhere divide by a different quantity — the same misstated scaling factor as the ground truth.
No finding mentions the text-token zero block in Eq. (13) or the inconsistent application of B to 0_{N_t}.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Points at a transpose/shape convention issue in the cross-attention that is inherent to the underlying paper, not at any listed corruption.
Criticises the paper's loose claim that the nonlinear, block-wise update is a single matrix ΔW — a pre-existing framing weakness, not the corrupted Eq. (3) or the B·0 term.
Correctly identifies the altered softmax normaliser in the cross-attention equations.
